Ranks all Montgomery census tracts by 2025 code violations per 1,000 residents using pre-aggregated tract counts left-joined to tract population, with zero counts retained and geoid last for mapping.
sql:
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT geoid, n AS code_violations
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261025_db959e' AND source = 'm1_city' AND grp = 'all'
),
pop AS (
  SELECT tractfips AS geoid, CAST(totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation
  FROM session.fw_db959e_population_cdc
)
SELECT
  t.name,
  CASE
    WHEN p.totalpopulation IS NOT NULL AND p.totalpopulation > 0
    THEN COALESCE(c.code_violations, 0) / p.totalpopulation * 1000
  END AS code_violations_per_1000_totalpopulation,
  COALESCE(c.code_violations, 0) AS code_violations,
  p.totalpopulation,
  t.geoid
FROM fw_pg.tracts t
LEFT JOIN counts c ON t.geoid = c.geoid
LEFT JOIN pop p ON t.geoid = p.geoid
WHERE t.geoid IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY code_violations_per_1000_totalpopulation DESC NULLS LAST, t.name ASC
LIMIT 200
